query: I have a small kitchen. Should I get an air fryer or a countertop convection oven?
plausible_answers: Answer A (Combo Convection Oven Default): Get a compact countertop convection oven with air fry mode — it replaces your toaster, air fryer, and secondary oven in one footprint, which is the right trade-off for small kitchens even if peak air frying performance is slightly lower.

Answer B (Dedicated Air Fryer for Best Results): Buy a dedicated air fryer if air frying is your primary use case — the higher fan speed and dedicated chamber produce noticeably crispier results than combo units for wings, fries, and vegetables.

Answer C (Air Fryer for Efficiency): Choose a dedicated air fryer for energy efficiency and speed — for single-person or couple households cooking small batches daily, the faster heat-up time and lower energy use make it the more practical everyday appliance.
